capabilities: Chat with the active note, a selected passage, or @-referenced notes as context
Configure OpenAI-compatible providers, endpoints, models, and API keys
Copy, insert, or regenerate replies, or replace the active note with a reply
Resume the last conversation from locally stored history
Stop or retry generation and see request status
extras: API key and chat history are stored unencrypted in data.json inside the vault; the README advises excluding that file from sync, Git, and backups. Third-party providers may charge for requests, and the connection test may consume API quota.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask an LLM questions about the note you are working on without leaving the app.

relations.evidence: The plugin connects Obsidian to an OpenAI-compatible chat API.
For Ollama, start the local service and install a model first.

requires.name: Provider API key (OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, or custom endpoint)

summary: Sidebar chat that sends the active note, a selection, or @-referenced notes as context to an OpenAI-compatible LLM.
